description: randomSeed(42) selects a fixed random() sequence; reseeding restarts it.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: Park-Miller minimal standard generator of avr-libc (x = 16807*(x mod 127773) - 2836*(x div 127773), + 2^31-1 if negative; seed 0 would use 123459876) with random(max) = random() % max and random(a, b) = a + random(b - a), computed independently in Python
